scope: minimal affine, unpublished prototype kernel: persistent device workspace, record-free pipeline, integrated coverage, full telemetry, real canvas size. NOT published into the production runner.

per_frame: H2D upload of the normalized source frame (fp32) and optional per-source-pixel sigma2 plane into reserved device slots
dense scatter kernel into frame-local internal-resolution planes A, B_src (source-valid weight), B_geo (geometric weight incl. nonfinite values), and optional S2 (area-weighted sigma2)

fused fold+accumulate kernel per native pixel per channel: b_f = sum_j area_j*B_src_fj, a_f = sum_j area_j*A_fj over the internal subpixels; accumulate full-stream B += b_f, B2 += b_f^2, contributors; reservoir keep predicate splitmix64(frame_order^seed) < floor(2^64*R/N) appends {x=a_f/b_f, b_f, frame_order, sigma2_f}; support bitmasks per layer; footprint count when b_f > 0
at_band_end: finalize kernel per native pixel per channel: deterministic (x, frame_order) insertion sort of the reservoir, weighted median / weighted MAD iterative clip identical to the CPU oracle (robust_frame_oracle_v2), uniform combine over accepted, confidence finalize over accepted sigma2
D2H download of result planes only: value, B, n_eff, confidence, conf_state, support fractions; coverage scalars
no host contribution records anywhere; no device download of frame planes or reservoirs in the production path (tests may download them for oracle comparison)

gate5_amendment.reason: the clip-accepted confidence contract requires sigma2 per kept candidate; it cannot be recomputed at fold time
gate5_amendment.reservoir_record: 32 B = x(8) + b(8) + frame_order(8) + sigma2(8); was 24 B in the gate-5 role table
gate5_amendment.reservoir_slots: 2*R device slots (128 for R=64): the hash-keep set is Binomial(N, R/N) and can exceed R; slots beyond R absorb the tail, and a pixel exceeding the slot cap degrades deterministically to reservoir_overflow_uniform (uniform A/B value, support kept). Hash predicate and kept set are unchanged - bit-parity with the CPU oracle holds for every non-overflow pixel
gate5_amendment.reservoir_kept_count: 4 B per native pixel per channel
gate5_amendment.frame_planes: 3 (+1 optional sigma2) doubles per internal pixel per channel: A, B_src, B_geo replace 'frame A/B' role
gate5_amendment.coverage: per native pixel per channel: contributors u32 + covB/covB2 (2 doubles) + support mask u16; per pixel: footprint u32
gate5_amendment.spec_delta: role-table revision recorded in the gate-5 decision artifact; planner re-run with amended roles

oracle_parity_contract.fold: per-frame subpixel fold identical to fold_native_pixel_v2 algebra (area-weighted sums, frame before square)
oracle_parity_contract.clip: reservoir clip must be BIT-IDENTICAL to robust_frame_oracle_v2 on the same candidate set: (x,frame_order) order, weighted median at cumulative weight >= total/2, weighted MAD with (|x-median|, frame_order) order, asymmetric bounds, early stop on unchanged mask, MAD=0 collapses bounds to the median, below min_clip_contributors accepts all
oracle_parity_contract.reservoir: kept set must equal the CPU predicate exactly for the same (frame_order sequence, N, R, seed)
oracle_parity_contract.confidence: conf stats over clip-accepted members; fallback_n_eff when no sigma2; support untouched
oracle_parity_contract.tolerance: 0 ULP target for value/B/n_eff/confidence; documented 1e-12 fallback for atomics-order drift in B accumulation

coverage_contract.cfa_geometry: per channel: sum_f B_geo_f, contributors, support fraction - accumulated during the same pass, never a second sweep
coverage_contract.dense_footprint: per native pixel: frame footprint count (b_f_out > 0 in any channel); dense_common_overlap = footprint == frame_count, computed at finalize
coverage_contract.geometry_vs_source: B_geo counts overlaps of nonfinite source samples too; B_src does not - the two layers stay separated per gate 2

required_counters: allocations (must be 0 during the frame loop; reserve() counts once)
telemetry_contract.slot_states: source slot state transitions FREE->HOST_FILLING->UPLOADING->COMPUTING->FREE counted per transition

gates.oracle: device finalize vs CPU oracle: value/B/n_eff/confidence within 1e-12, states and support identical, on small canvases covering all bayer patterns, mono, partial support, nonfinite sources, N<=R and N>R
gates.support: four-layer fractions and footprint equal the CPU reference exactly
gates.flux: sum of device B_src equals sum of CPU gather B per band within 1e-12 relative
gates.memory: reserved_device_bytes <= gate-5 plan device_peak for the same band; no cudaMalloc/cudaFree between reserve() and finalize()
gates.time: steady-state upload+scatter+accumulate <= 0.75 s per frame on production geometry (7868x4540 internal, 3840x2160 source, pixfrac 0.8) - same bound as the gate-1 enumeration gate, now covering the longer pipeline
gates.determinism: accept masks, support masks, kept sets and states are bit-identical across runs; value planes may drift <= 1e-12 relative because atomicAdd ordering is not a guaranteed contract

test_matrix.standard: small-canvas parity (64x48 native, scales 1/2, mono/osc, 4 bayer patterns, N=3/40), nonfinite source, empty band, single frame, N>R reservoir sampling equality, determinism
test_matrix.hidden: production canvas 7868x4540 internal / 3934x2270 native, N=60 real-derived affine transforms, pixfrac 0.8, telemetry and time gates, memory-vs-plan check

deferred: publication into the production runner: gate 10
multiband halo/ring buffers and fusion: gate 9
quality-stream (Q) slots: provider exists, kernel weighting wired when gate 9 calibrates confidence
